description: This script manages log backup and recovery processes, including creating log directories, handling log files, performing disk size checks, and managing log backups during system reboots or shutdowns.

methods.name: backupAndRecoverLogs
methods.description: Performs backup or recovery operations on specified log files based on provided source, destination, and operation.

methods.name: backupLogsNotInList
methods.description: Backs up log files not in the predefined list to a trash directory.
